hero.headline:
Celebrating 10 years of 
RoboGrinder.
hero.intro: Bringing Virginia Tech students together through competitive robotics since 2016.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.tagline: Turn classroom knowledge into hands-on experience.
mission.description: Students learn tools used in industry as they design parts, build circuits, write software, and test the team’s robots. Working together builds practical engineering, problem-solving, and teamwork skills for their future careers. Students from every major are welcome.
mission.imageAlt: RoboGrinder students celebrating at a robotics competition with their robots
